Three defects in `copy()`, all measured against `php -n` 8.5.6, found by following the round-7
audit probe that copies across wrappers.

## A failed copy truncated an existing destination

    copy("missing.txt", "out.txt");
    file_exists("out.txt")     php: false     elephc: TRUE

php opens the SOURCE first and never touches the destination when that open fails. elephc read the
